posts.trend: Delhi's New P-10 Permit Rule: ₹15,000 Wedding Liquor Fee, Separate Approval for Every Hall
posts.context: The administrative apparatus treats private family events as commercial venues subject to strict licensing.
posts.angle: Corporate compliance policies feel lax compared to the legal terms of drinking at your own wedding.
slides: Terms and conditions for drinking at your own reception.

Clause 1: Pay ₹15,000 per hall prior to guest entry.
Clause 2: Separate license required if guests step onto the lawn.
Clause 3: Uncles dancing after 11 PM remain your personal liability.

Compliance rate: 100%.

The bride's father is still paying in cash.
posts.caption: Every family has one person who reads the excise T&Cs at 2 AM.
posts.rank_verdict: Slide 1 fails as a title card that clears its throat instead of delivering a real line.
